input: 很多企业使用普通 AI，不代表我们的 Agentic AI 图表核对应用已经普及。
basis: Explicit user selection in this conversation
english_reflection: My main takeaway is that widespread use of ordinary AI does not show that our agentic chart-review application is widespread. For this case, I would first check whether a statistic measures the same technology and workflow before treating it as peer evidence. Keeping those levels separate makes the timing judgment more useful: broad uptake can motivate learning, while a claim about this application still needs its own evidence.
editing_note: English expression developed with AI from the student-selected takeaway; no additional personal learning event is claimed.
